title: Urine salts elucidate Early Neolithic animal management at Aşıklı Höyük, Turkey
version: Science Advances 5, eaaw0038. Author list abbreviated.
lineage: Primary soil and sediment chemistry from the site, a different set of measurements than the zooarchaeological counts and ages. Some excavation-team authors overlap.

passages.note: Levels 5–4 date to approximately 10,400–10,000 cal BP. Modelled human-and-animal inputs of urine salts rise markedly through the occupational sequence.
